objectives:
本課程主要介紹一些關於影像處理問題的數學研究。 它的兩個主要目標是：

(1) 介紹適用於數位圖像處理的基本概念和方法，並為進一步研究奠定基礎。

(2) 提供一些數學技術來研究影像處理中的幾個基本問題，例如如何恢復退化的圖像以及如何將其分割成有意義的區域等。

***************
萬一需要時視訊教學的 Google Meet連結：https://meet.google.com/sqs-sqhs-rkf
content:
本課程預計將包含下列主題：
(1) Basic concepts of digital image processing
(2) Intensity transformations and spatial filtering
(3) Variational methods for image denoising
(4) Variational methods for image deblurring
(5) Multi-focus image fusion and guided filter
(6) Image dehazing: atmospheric scattering model and dark channel prior
(7) Variational methods for image contrast enhancement
(8) Image inpainting: variational methods and sparse representation
(9) Variational image segmentation: Mumford-Shah and Chan-Vese models
(10) Principal component pursuit problems

Course homepage: http://www.math.ncu.edu.tw/~syyang/
books:
(1) [AK2002] G. Aubert and P. Kornprobst, Mathematical Problems in Image Processing: Partial Differential Equations and the Calculus of Variations, Second Edition, Springer Verlag, New York, 2002.

(2) [CS2005] T. F. Chan and J. Shen, Image Processing and Analysis: Variational, PDE, Wavelet, and Stochastic Methods, Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics, Philadelphia, 2005.

(3) [TUM2019] D. Cremers, Computer Vision I: Variational Methods, Online Resources, Departments of Informatics ＆ Mathematics, Technical University of Munich, Germany, 2019/2020.

(4) [GW2018] R. C. Gonzalez and R. E. Woods, Digital Image Processing, Fourth Edition, Pearson Education Limited, New York, 2018.
